## Summary

Describe the proposed change and why it helps.

## Reproduction / Context

Provide enough detail to reproduce the issue or evaluate the proposal. For behavior changes, cite the RFC 9485 section that supports the new result.

## Checklist

- [ ] I understand this project does not merge external PRs directly.
- [ ] I included a minimal repro case, fixture, or test where applicable.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --all-features --locked` pass.
- [ ] I confirm I have the right to submit this content.
